QF.id: Introduction to AML, CFT and Proliferation Financing_16

question.text: The Financial Action Task Force (FATF) issued a set of __________ recommendations that serve as the international standard for combating money laundering, terrorist financing, and proliferation financing.

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook states that FATF has issued forty recommendations and that FATF leads global action against money laundering, terrorist financing and proliferation financing. The keyed answer of 40 is taken directly from that source statement. The Trap: The round numbers 20, 30 and 50 are plausible distractors only because FATF-related figures are commonly half-remembered; the workbook is explicit on 40 Recommendations. Note: Details such as the historical 40 + 9 Special Recommendations, scope across legal systems, and the use of FATF standards in India's PMLA framework are not relied upon in this explanation because they were not located on the source pages checked for this item.
